name: @open-neko/plugin-resend
description: Operational email for OpenNeko through Resend. The agent sends an email from a Resend template, from Markdown in a house layout, or from HTML, and checks delivery status. Rules match the real recipient domains. Network egress limited to api.resend.com.

env.description: Resend API key (starts with re_). Create it at resend.com → API Keys with Sending access, or Full access to also list templates. The gateway holds the key; the plugin sandbox never sees it.
Sender for every email, e.g. "Acme Ops <ops@mail.acme.com>". The domain must be verified in Resend. The agent cannot change it.
Default reply-to address. The agent can set another one per email.
Comma-separated recipient domains, e.g. "acme.com, *.acme.com, partner.com". When set, the plugin refuses any other recipient, even on an approved email.
HTTPS URL of the logo at the top of the house layout (Markdown emails only).
Hex color for links and the top border in the house layout, e.g. #1f6feb.
One line at the bottom of the house layout, e.g. "Sent by OpenNeko for Acme Operations."

kinds.description: Send one email. Give to (and optional cc, bcc), a subject, and exactly one body: template (a Resend template id or alias with variables), markdown (rendered in the house layout), or html.

example.subject: Low stock: 3 SKUs below reorder point
example.markdown:
## Low stock

| SKU | On hand | Reorder point |
|---|---|---|
| WB-120 | 4 | 20 |

The next purchase order is due on 02 October.

kinds.description: List the published Resend templates: id, alias, and name.
Get one Resend template by id or alias: its subject and the variable keys it expects.
Get the delivery status of a sent email by the id that send_email returned, e.g. delivered, bounced, or opened.
